integration.interface_adaptation: Eleven independent Codex schemas replace aggregate operation/scope/kind/snapshot-cursor fields; Unicode code-point coordinates, task projection by default, targeted internal tool inspection.
integration.regressions: Manual /compact state machine and real SDK automatic rollover, precise matching regions, canonical text/source correlation, complete 6000-character index records, request-local aggregate-guidance migration.

follow_up.fix: Register required child extensions with task.agent.sessionId (Pi runtime ID), retaining file-based sessionKey for durable storage only.
follow_up.preflight_limit: Public preflight reports required extension IDs and deliberately omits private required extension paths. SDK tests separately load the generated entry.

history_probe.scope: Offline fixture through actual registered history tools; defaults unchanged, no relevance ranking or deduplication claim.

notes_recovery_follow_up.restored_instruction: Take incremental notes while you work so you do not miss important info.

reset_index.scope: Current agent notes, captured at the shared rollover builder; other agents remain explicitly accessible through existing notes tools.
reset_index.path_encoding: Complete JSON rows with canonical virtual paths that can be passed unchanged to notes_read_file.
reset_index.omitted_files: Report omitted count and point to notes_list_files_by_prefix.
reset_index.empty_or_failed: Distinguish no files from index unavailable; a listing failure never blocks rollover.
reset_index.prompt_role: Stable workflow stays in system guidance; reset-time note metadata stays in bootstrap compaction data. Note bodies require an explicit tool read.

coverage: Filesystem integration: update ordering, byte size, timestamps, paths containing quotes and newlines, exact-path readback, 25-file and 6000-character bounds, empty stores, and directory listing errors.

Real Pi SDK with an offline stream: restored instruction reaches provider system content; a manual checkpoint triggers rollover; the next provider request sees the actual notes path before recovery; notes_read_file restores the checkpoint body.
Provider-context assertions support both Pi 0.84 systemPrompt and Pi 1.5 system messages, avoiding the Pi 1.5 after-run session.systemPrompt getter that clears the per-run override.
Both Pi 0.84.4 and isolated Pi 1.5.0 passed typecheck and all eight test suites. Installed compatible-fork and upstream pi-subagents public API contracts also passed.
notes_recovery_follow_up.behavior_limit: Prompt delivery and recovery are verified. No new runtime requirement enforces a notes write before every final answer; offline streams do not measure real-model adherence.

release_validation.pinned_environment: Pi 0.84.4; the manual compaction fix passed typecheck and all eight test suites, including checkpoint failure/retry and cancellation regressions.
release_validation.latest_environment: Pi 1.5.0; typecheck and all eight test suites passed. Real TUI checks verified successful manual rollover without a cancellation error and Esc followed by resumed conversation. No online model was called.
release_validation.package_contents: Explicit files allowlist: runtime TypeScript, license, README, CHANGELOG, and current documentation. Tests, fixtures, scripts, CI files, credential files, office documents, and obsolete reports are excluded.

plaintext_schema_follow_up.reference: The frozen Codex fixture is unchanged. Comparison explicitly removes only the four declared reference annotations and the two Pi paging extensions.

manual_compact_follow_up.root_cause: The former manual checkpoint workflow cancelled the first native compaction to run the checkpoint, then retried. Pi rendered the intentional cancellation as an error.
manual_compact_follow_up.change: Keep the native session_before_compact hook pending until the checkpoint agent settles; return rollover content built from the latest branch in the same native attempt.
preserved: One successful write or append to own notes before rollover.
No context replacement inside the checkpoint tool batch.
Esc cancels the checkpoint run and native manual compaction.
A saved checkpoint remains reusable after cancellation or rollover failure.
An unsaved checkpoint retains the current window and fence.
Nested automatic compaction cannot bypass or reset the active manual checkpoint.
